items.contentChinese: 创作任务 以用户上传的照片为唯一人物参考，创作一幅具有当代艺术感的马克笔人物画。保留照片中人物的身份、神态、姿势和辨识度，但彻底重新组织颜色、笔触和画面空间。不是给照片套上绘画滤镜，而是像一位有观察力、有幽默感的画家，看过这个人之后，用几支颜色浓郁的宽头马克笔，把这个瞬间重新画出来。画面应当大胆、浓厚、松弛，有鲜明的手工痕迹。第一眼被大色块吸引，第二眼认出照片中的人，第三眼发现旁边那句有点好笑的手写文字。艺术方向参考亨利·马蒂斯剪纸作品中鲜明的纯色关系、简化的人物轮廓，以及色块与留白之间的节奏。文字与幽默参考大卫·史瑞格里作品中简练的绘画、手写短句，以及对日常生活荒诞之处的观察。本次创作应更温暖，不沿用黑暗、尖刻的语气。统一成一种明确的视觉语言：浓色、宽笔、简化造型、真实神态、少量手写旁注。媒介为浓厚的不透明颜料马克笔，大色块应饱满、扎实、具有覆盖感，让人能看见笔经过纸面的痕迹。色彩浓重、鲜明，放弃统一的浅粉彩、奶油肤色和淡蓝背景设定。根据照片里的服装、肤色和情绪，选择一组有限而有力度的配色。通常使用四至六种主要颜色，以一种主导色建立整体气氛，一种对照色制造张力，再用少量强调色点亮画面。构图与背景根据原图提取主要人物，删除无关路人、杂物和复杂环境。默认延续原图的横竖方向与关键动作。构图松弛而准确。背景以一整块主色或两块大的颜色区域构成。可以适度裁切、放大和调整主体位置，但不要把有意义的全身动作一律裁成头像。手写文字：像画家看着这个人，忍不住写了一句。文字应当让人觉得：“这句话是看过这张照片才想到的。”采用轻微反差、一本正经的玩笑、拟人化的小抱怨，或日常生活中的微小荒诞。主句控制在三至八个英文单词，另可添加一个一至三个单词的小旁注。除日期外，文字最多形成两组。时间戳落款在画面右下角或下方留白处，以更小、更轻的手写字落下实际创作日期。最终控制避免写实照片质感、半写实 AI 油画、柔软喷枪渐变、透明水彩晕染、粉彩糖果色、塑料皮肤、动漫大眼、三维卡通、矢量轮廓、满画面黑色描边，以及过度精细的头发和织物纹理。最终画面应当像一幅可以挂在小型画廊里的马克笔人物作品：远看，色块鲜明而有秩序；近看，笔触有停顿、有覆盖、有人的手感；再看，人物仍然是照片里的那个人，而旁边的一句小字，让整个瞬间突然有了性格。

items.title: 现代风女性服饰提示词合集：花呢套装与轻盈礼服
items.summary: 整理一组现代风女性服饰提示词，涵盖冰蓝花呢套装、象牙白珍珠套装、薄荷绿单肩礼服和樱花粉花瓣露肩礼服。
items.contentChinese: 现代风女性服饰提示词合集，保留四套浅色造型的服装结构、配色、材质和装饰细节，不新增人物、场景或叙事：1. 冰蓝色短款圆领花呢外套，敞襟设计，毛边、珍珠纽扣、小贴袋，银色水晶胸针和垂坠珍珠；同色半透明灯笼长袖，袖口双层荷叶边，薄纱从肩背垂至裙摆下方；内搭奶油白细罗纹吊带，心形浅V领、微抽褶，下摆收进裙腰；搭配冰蓝高腰A字百褶短裙、细腰带、银扣、银链和小吊坠项链。2. 象牙白短款圆领花呢外套，敞襟、利落肩线、修身长袖，珍珠与香槟金饰边，双贴袋与金边珍珠纽扣；内搭奶油白缎面吊带，浅荡领；同色高腰不对称裹身短裙，斜褶裥、多层荷叶边，香槟金细链点缀小珍珠。3. 浅薄荷绿单肩收腰短礼服，斜领与胸前褶裥汇聚左肩，银白花枝刺绣、淡绿叶片和珠饰；左肩半透明薄纱长披带低垂；同色宽缎面腰带、香槟金细链、叶片和贝壳吊饰、水滴珍珠细链；A字伞形短裙，薄纱外层与花枝刺绣裙边。4. 浅樱花粉露肩短礼服，心形抹胸由层叠薄纱花瓣构成，胸前褶裥向中央汇聚，珍珠与缎带蝴蝶结；腰腹横向抽褶，侧腰纱花与蝴蝶结，长系带下垂；半透明露肩灯笼长袖，小珍珠点缀，粉色细缎带收口并接宽大喇叭荷叶袖口；短裙以浅粉至奶油白多层薄纱荷叶边叠加，点缀珍珠。
items.contentEnglish: Modern women's fashion prompt set, preserving the clothing structure, color palette, materials, and decorative details of four light-toned looks, with no added characters, scenes, or narrative: 1. An ice-blue short round-neck tweed jacket with an open-front design, raw edges, pearl buttons, and small patch pockets, plus a silver crystal brooch and dangling pearls; matching semi-transparent lantern sleeves, with double-layer ruffle cuffs and sheer tulle falling from the shoulders and back to below the skirt hem; a cream-white fine ribbed camisole with a soft heart-shaped shallow V-neck, slight gathering, and a hem tucked into the waistband; paired with an ice-blue high-waisted A-line pleated mini skirt, slim belt, silver buckle, silver chain, and a small pendant necklace. 2. An ivory short round-neck tweed jacket with an open-front design, clean shoulder line, fitted long sleeves, pearl and champagne-gold trims, double patch pockets, and gold-edged pearl buttons; a cream-white satin camisole with a soft draped neckline; a matching high-waisted asymmetrical wrap mini skirt with diagonal pleats, layered ruffles, and a champagne-gold fine chain accented with small pearls. 3. A light mint-green one-shoulder fitted short dress, with an oblique neckline and chest pleats converging at the left shoulder, decorated with silver-white floral embroidery, pale green leaves, and beadwork; a matching semi-transparent long tulle drape hanging from the left shoulder; a wide satin belt in the same color, champagne-gold fine chain, leaf and shell pendants, and a double water-drop pearl chain; an A-line umbrella mini skirt with a sheer outer layer and floral embroidery along the hem. 4. A light cherry blossom pink off-shoulder short dress, with a heart-shaped strapless bodice formed by layered tulle petals, chest pleats gathered toward the center, and pearl plus ribbon bows; horizontal gathered ruching at the waist and abdomen, side tulle flowers and bows, and long ties hanging down; semi-transparent off-shoulder lantern sleeves with small pearl accents, pink narrow ribbon cuffs leading into wide flared ruffle cuffs; a mini skirt layered with multiple tiers of pale pink to cream-white sheer ruffles, accented with pearls.

items.title: image2.5人像测试 {角色}，明确成年角色，时尚杂志级低机位 Editorial 角色摄影 × 高级奇幻人像
items.summary: 整理X案例：提供成人角色图像生成提示词，强调人像构图、光影、服装细节和竖版格式。
items.contentChinese:
image2.5人像测试
{角色}，明确成年角色，时尚杂志级低机位 Editorial 角色摄影 × 高级奇幻人像。保留角色标志性发型、服装、饰品、兽耳、武器或职业符号，并转译为真实高定 COS / fashion editorial 造型。人物斜倚、半坐或侧坐，一侧膝腿靠近镜头形成自然前景透视与近大远小效果，脸部位于画面中上区域，微侧头、垂眸、浅笑或冷静凝视。35–50mm 近距离低机位拍摄，浅景深，局部自然越框。背景根据角色设定自动适配为暗色东方建筑、奇幻室内、月夜庭院或高级舞台空间。暖金/柔白主光塑造面部，洋红或角色代表色轮廓光勾勒发丝与服装边缘，少量冷蓝环境光分离背景；轻 halation，真实细腻肤质，干净暗部，高级时尚杂志调色，无短视频压缩感。左上角加入 stylized “V” × 猫元素 Logo，右下角加入手写签名“voxCAT”，服装或配件可加入低调 VOXCAT 织标或金属铭牌。9:16 竖版，画面干净清晰，细节稳定。
items.contentEnglish:
Image2.5 portrait test
{Character}, explicit adult character, fashion magazine low-angle Editorial character photography × advanced fantasy portrait. Preserve the character's signature hairstyle, clothing, accessories, animal ears, weapons, or occupational symbols, and translate them into real high-end COS / fashion editorial styling. The character leans diagonally, half-sits or sits sideways, with one knee close to the lens creating natural foreground perspective and near-large-far-small effect, face in the upper center of the frame, head slightly tilted, eyes drooping, shallow smile or calm gaze. 35–50mm close-up low-angle shot, shallow depth of field, partial natural cropping. Background automatically adapts to dark Eastern architecture, fantasy interior, moonlit courtyard or high-end stage space based on character setting. Warm gold/soft white main light sculpts the face, magenta or character's representative color rim light outlines hair and clothing edges, minimal cold blue ambient light separates the background; light halation, realistic fine skin texture, clean shadows, advanced fashion magazine color grading, no short video compression feel. Add stylized "V" × cat element logo in the upper left corner, handwritten signature "voxCAT" in the lower right corner, clothing or accessories may add low-key VOXCAT fabric label or metal plaque. 9:16 vertical version, clean and clear image, stable details.

items.title: 极简墨线风景小笺：旅行照片对比海报
items.summary: 将旅行照片提炼成独立极简墨线小笺对比海报，保留高保真上方照片与下方轻盈墨线转绘，3:4竖版构图。
items.contentChinese:
将我上传的每一张旅行照片分别制作成一张独立的「极简墨线风景小笺」对比海报，不多图拼接，每张照片单独输出。
整体采用3:4竖版构图，明确保留“上方原始照片、下方风格转绘”的视觉对照。上下区域可根据原图内容自然调整比例，不必机械均分，但两部分必须边界清楚、阅读关系明确，并共同构成一张完整的编辑设计作品。
上半部分高保真保留原始照片：保持地点、主体、建筑结构、人物姿态、自然光影、空间层次和原有色彩氛围，不得替换场景、改变关键物体、拉伸主体或虚构原图中不存在的地标。仅进行轻微而克制的杂志摄影调色；如需适配画幅，可自然延展天空、水面、地面或环境背景。
下半部分使用温润的米白色或自然纸白作为完整底面，将照片提炼为一幅缩小的极简墨线风景小稿。不要完整照搬原图，也不要把整个画面平均线描；应主动筛选画面中最有识别度和诗意的少数信息，例如：一个建筑或地貌结构锚点、一条山脊或水岸线、一株具有姿态的植物、一名小人物或一件旅行物件，以及一至两条天气与空间线索。
删除无关人群、杂乱植被、重复建筑和琐碎背景。转绘主体仅占下半区域宽度约38%–62%，保留约55%–72%连续、完整、可感知的纸白。
线条使用黑色或深灰黑色的细钢笔、干墨与轻微毛笔飞白质感：允许粗细变化、停顿、断续、纸齿、漏墨和未闭合轮廓，使其像旅行途中迅速但准确留下的观察小稿。
建筑依靠少量结构线表现比例，山峰与远景只保留稀疏轮廓，水面、雾气、天空与距离主要通过留白完成；植物不逐片描绘叶子，而以枝干方向和极少墨点表现姿态。避免灰墨大面积铺染，避免画成完整传统山水画或精密建筑制图。
配色以黑墨为主，只允许从原照片中提取最多两种小面积强调色，例如朱砂红、秋叶赭黄、荷花淡粉、苔藓灰绿或渔网暖黄。强调色总面积不超过下半画面的8%，仅落在一个最有记忆点的局部，不做水彩满铺、彩色轮廓或高饱和装饰。
文字应像小型旅行出版物的页眉与图注，数量少但清楚可读。根据照片内容生成一个简短英文标题，搭配编号字段“INK NOTE 01”和一句极短英文观察句。
标题可使用克制的衬线体、打字机体或略带手工不齐的印刷体；文字放在主要留白区域，与插画保持呼吸距离，不压住主体，不使用华丽书法，不生成中文印章、作者签名、品牌名或水印。不同图片只更换标题、编号和观察句，整体版式与字体气质保持统一。
最终画面应呈现真实旅行摄影与轻盈墨线观察稿之间的明确对照；安静、克制、疏朗，像一页从独立旅行刊物、建筑观察册或私人速写本中取出的纸本小笺。重点不是炫技，而是通过删减、停笔与纸白，让原照片中的一个地点、一种天气或一个短暂动作被重新看见。
避免：整张照片直接线稿滤镜化、上下内容完全重复、下半铺满画面、连续灰色晕染、传统国画满构图、复杂树叶、精密交叉排线、漫画化建筑、卡通人物、水彩填色、高饱和撞色、伪中文、复制照片中的招牌文字、作者姓名、水印、电商模板感和廉价复古滤镜。
items.contentEnglish:
Create an independent "Minimal Ink Line Landscape Note" comparison poster for each uploaded travel photo, no multiple image splicing, each photo output separately.
Overall 3:4 vertical composition, clearly retain "upper original photo, lower style drawing" visual comparison. Upper and lower areas can naturally adjust proportions based on original content, not necessarily mechanical equal division, but boundaries must be clear, reading relationship clear, and together form a complete edited design work.
Upper part: high-fidelity retention of original photo: keep location, subject, architectural structure, character posture, natural light and shadow, spatial hierarchy and original color atmosphere, not replace scenes, change key objects, stretch subjects or fabricate landmarks not existing in original image. Only mild restrained magazine photography color grading; if needed to adapt frame, naturally extend sky, water surface, ground or environment background.
Lower part: use warm ivory white or natural paper white as complete base, refine the photo into a miniature simplified ink line landscape draft. Not directly copy entire original image, nor average line tracing whole; actively select few most recognizable and poetic elements from the image, such as one building or terrain structure anchor, one ridge or waterline, one plant with posture, one small figure or travel object, and one to two weather and space clues.
Delete irrelevant crowds, messy vegetation, repeated buildings and trivial backgrounds. The drawn subject occupies about 38%–62% of lower region width, retaining about 55%–72% continuous, complete, perceptible paper white.
Lines use black or deep gray fine pen, dry ink with slight brush flyback texture: allow thickness variation, pauses, breaks, paper teeth, ink leakage and open contours, like rapidly but accurately observed small drafts left along the travel path.
Buildings rely on a few structural lines to show proportion, mountain peaks and distant views only retain sparse outlines, water surface, mist, sky and distance mainly completed through blank space; plants not depict leaves one by one, but use branch direction and very few ink dots to show posture. Avoid gray ink large area coverage, avoid turning into complete traditional landscape painting or precise architectural blueprint.
Color scheme mainly black ink, only allow extracting up to two small area accent colors from original photo, such as cinnabar red, autumn ochre yellow, lotus light pink, moss gray-green or fishing net warm yellow. Accent color total area not exceed 8% of lower half drawing, only falls in one local memory point, not watercolor full coverage, colored outline or high saturation decoration.
Text like page header and caption in small travel publications, small quantity but clearly readable. Generate short English title according to photo content, paired with number field "INK NOTE 01" and one extremely short English observation sentence.
Titles can use restrained serif, typewriter or slightly uneven handmade printed style; text placed in main blank area, with illustration maintaining breathing distance, not covering subject, not using luxurious calligraphy, not generating Chinese seals, author signatures, brand names or watermarks. Different images only replace title, number and observation sentence, overall layout and font temperament kept unified.
Final image should present clear comparison between real travel photography and light ink line observation draft; quiet, restrained, airy, like a page taken from independent travel publication, architectural observation book or private sketchbook. Emphasis not on showing skill, but through deletion, pausing and paper white, let one location, one weather or one brief action in original photo be seen again.
Avoid: whole photo directly line drawing filterization, upper and lower content completely repeated, lower half fully filling the picture, continuous gray haze, traditional Chinese painting full composition, complex foliage, precise crossing lines, cartoonized architecture, cartoon characters, watercolor coloring, high saturation clash colors, fake Chinese, copying billboards in photo, author name, watermark, e-commerce template feel and cheap retro filters.

items.title: 使用ChatGPT image2.5将人物照片抽象成东方水墨线条海报
items.summary: ChatGPT image2.5将人物照片抽象成东方水墨线条海报，保留辨识度、大面积留白、黑线骨架、朱红墨绿点睛并加小印章。
items.contentChinese:
请严格以我上传的参考图为唯一主体参考来源。

首先分析并提取参考图中最具有辨识度的视觉要素，包括：

主体身份与类型
面部或头部特征
发型、耳朵、角、帽子等头部轮廓
服装、配饰、道具
身体姿态与动作方向
最有辨识度的外轮廓
主体之间的关系
原图中具有代表性的色彩
能够体现主体身份的标志性细节

不要机械描摹参考图，也不要追求照片级写实复制。

在保证主体“一眼仍然能够被认出”的前提下，对参考图进行高度概括、抽象化和东方艺术化重新创作。

将主体转译为具有强烈中国东方美学气质的现代抽象手绘线条艺术。

整体采用极致简约的毛笔线条与现代线描语言，通过少量但富有表现力的曲线重新概括主体结构。

线条具有明显的手绘毛笔感，粗细自然变化，带有轻微飞白、墨迹干湿变化与手工笔触。

大量使用修长、流畅、飘逸的艺术曲线。

部分线条可以从主体结构自然延伸出去，形成类似书法运笔、衣带、水流、风、云气一般的长曲线，使画面产生明显的速度感、方向感和东方韵律。

不要把所有结构完整画出来。

允许通过断线、留白、几笔概括、局部缺失和视觉联想来表现主体。

重点保留最具有识别度的轮廓、姿态和标志性元素，其余细节大胆舍弃。

色彩控制在极少数量。

以黑色线条作为主要视觉骨架，并根据参考图本身的代表性色彩，提取 1—2 种强调色进行艺术化使用。

优先允许使用：
黑色、朱红色、墨绿色。
颜色只作为局部点睛，不进行大面积填色。

部分标志性服装、配饰、道具或动作轨迹可以使用红色或绿色长线进行强调。

构图完整但极度克制。

主体位于画面视觉中心区域，可以适当打破常规比例，对身体、衣物、毛发、尾巴、道具或动作轨迹进行拉长和曲线化处理。

让主体像由几根正在流动的毛笔线条自然形成，而不是由封闭轮廓勾勒出来。

整体具有：
东方抽象艺术、
现代极简主义、
中国书法线条、
水墨速写、
传统神话插画、
现代编辑插画
融合后的视觉语言。

画面加入一枚小型传统朱红色篆刻印章。
印章文字根据参考图主体的身份、名字、昵称、角色特征或画面主题进行提炼，控制在 2—4 个汉字以内。
如果没有明确文字信息，则不要擅自添加具体姓名，可使用与主体气质相符的简短东方意象文字。
印章只是视觉点缀，尺寸较小，不抢主体。
背景保持极简。
使用细腻的米白色宣纸作为底色，具有非常轻微、自然、真实的纸张纤维纹理。
不要出现复杂场景、建筑、景物或装饰性背景。
画面四周必须保留大面积留白，尤其主体外围不要塞满元素。

利用留白与少量曲线形成东方绘画中的“虚实关系”和呼吸感。

最终效果应像：

“从一张真实参考图中提取灵魂与轮廓，再用几根飘逸的中国毛笔长线重新画了一遍。”

强调：
主体辨识度必须保留，
但不是照片复制；
结构高度概括，
但不能抽象到无法识别；
线条少而精准，
飘逸但不凌乱；
传统东方气质与现代设计感同时存在。

高清细腻，艺术海报级完成度，干净、克制、高级。

禁止：
写实照片效果、
3D渲染、
卡通Q版、
复杂背景、
大量颜色、
大面积色块、
密集细节、
机械描边、
封闭式矢量轮廓、
霓虹灯效果、
赛博朋克元素、
多余文字、
英文文字、
商业Logo、
水印。

画面重点始终是：
「参考图主体辨识度 + 极简毛笔线条 + 飘逸长曲线 + 东方留白 + 少量朱红/墨绿点睛」。
items.contentEnglish:
Please strictly take the reference image I uploaded as the only subject reference source.

First analyze and extract the most identifiable visual elements from the reference image, including:

subject identity and type
facial or head features
hairstyle, ears, horns, hats and other head outlines
clothing, accessories, props
body posture and direction of movement
most identifiable outer contour
relationships between subjects
representative colors in the original image
iconic details that reflect the subject's identity

Do not mechanically reproduce the reference image, nor pursue photo-level realistic replication.

On the premise that the subject can still be recognized at a glance, highly generalize, abstractize and Orientalize the reference image for recreation.

Translate the subject into a modern abstract hand-drawn line art with strong Chinese Oriental aesthetic temperament.

Overall, use extremely simple brush strokes and modern line drawing language to re-generalize the subject's structure with a small number of but expressive curves.

The lines have a clear hand-drawn brush feel, with natural thickness variations, slight feibai, ink wet-dry changes and manual strokes.

A large amount of slender, fluent, graceful artistic curves are used.

Some lines can naturally extend from the subject's structure, forming long curves similar to calligraphy strokes, ribbons, water flow, wind, or cloud qi, creating obvious speed, direction and Oriental rhythm.

Do not draw all structures completely.

It is allowed to use broken lines, blank spaces, sketchy few strokes, partial missing and visual association to represent the subject.

Focus on retaining the most identifiable contours, postures and iconic elements, boldly discarding other details.

Color control is limited to a very small number.

Black lines are used as the main visual skeleton, and 1-2 accent colors are extracted from the representative colors of the reference image for artistic use.

Priority is allowed to use:
black, cinnabar red, ink green.
Colors are only used as local accents, not large area coloring.

Some iconic clothing, accessories, props or action traces can use red or green long lines for emphasis.

Composition is complete but extremely restrained.

The subject is located in the center of the visual area, with appropriate breaking of conventional proportions, stretching and curving the body, clothing, hair, tail, props or action traces.

The subject is like formed naturally by a few flowing brush lines, rather than outlined with closed contours.

Overall it has:
Oriental abstract art,
modern minimalism,
Chinese calligraphy lines,
ink wash sketch,
traditional mythological illustration,
modern editorial illustration
fused visual language.

A small traditional cinnabar red seal is added to the image.
The seal text is refined based on the subject's identity, name, nickname, character features or image theme, controlled within 2-4 Chinese characters.
If there is no clear text information, do not add specific names arbitrarily, and can use short Oriental imagery text that matches the subject's temperament.
The seal is only a visual decoration, small in size, not competing with the subject.
The background is kept extremely simple.
A delicate off-white xuan paper is used as the base color, with very subtle, natural and realistic paper fiber texture.
No complex scenes, buildings, scenery or decorative backgrounds should appear.
A large area of blank space must be retained around the image, especially not filling elements around the subject periphery.

Use blank space and a small amount of curves to create the "virtual-real relationship" and breathing sense in Oriental painting.

The final effect should be like:

"Extract the soul and contours from a real reference image, then redraw it with a few elegant Chinese brush long lines."

Emphasize:
the subject's identification must be retained,
but it is not a photo copy;
the structure is highly generalized,
but not abstract to the point of unrecognizability;
the lines are few and precise,
graceful but not messy;
tradiional Oriental temperament and modern design sense coexist simultaneously.

High-definition and delicate, artistic poster-level completion, clean, restrained, and high-end.

Prohibited:
photorealistic photo effects,
3D rendering,
cartoon Q version,
complex backgrounds,
large amounts of color,
large area color blocks,
dense details,
mechanical outlines,
closed vector contours,
neon effects,
cyberpunk elements,
extra text,
English text,
commercial logos,
watermarks.

The focus of the image is always:
"reference image subject's identification + extremely simple brush lines + graceful long curves + Oriental blank space + small amount of cinnabar red / ink green accents".

items.title: 雪山之巅银凰仙姬东方神话人像提示词
items.summary: 超写实东方神话真人人像提示词，描绘雪山云海之巅的银凰仙姬，强调仙侠礼服、强风披帛、金色逆光与电影感构图。
items.contentChinese:
超写实真人东方神话电影人像，一名明确25岁以上的成年东亚女性，站在海拔极高的雪山云海之巅，塑造成来自雪域天界的银凰仙姬，整体融合东方仙侠、凤凰神话、冰雪圣女、高级时装 Editorial 与电影概念艺术。

人物拥有清冷精致的东方鹅蛋脸，面部轮廓柔和而立体，下颌线纤细自然，深色杏仁眼，眼神清冷、疏离、带轻微神性；细长自然眉，挺直精致鼻梁，淡珊瑚粉色嘴唇微微张开。

妆容使用极淡的冰雪仙侠妆，眼周加入少量暖橘红/浅珊瑚色眼影，与冷白雪山形成冷暖反差；真实皮肤毛孔与细微绒毛，面部具有自然透光感，不要网红脸，不要塑料磨皮。

人物头发为浓密乌黑超长发，古典高位半盘发与大量披发结合。高山强风从画面右侧向左后方猛烈吹过，大量黑色发丝向天空飞扬，部分细碎发丝横穿脸颊、嘴唇与眼睛附近，形成极强的动态电影抓拍感。

头顶佩戴大型银白凤凰羽翼发冠，造型融合凤凰展开的双翼、羽毛、冰晶与东方金属雕花，银色金属具有真实雕刻纹理和细小划痕。

发冠两侧垂落大量细长银色珠链、水晶流苏和珍珠链，随着强风向不同方向摆动。

佩戴大型珍珠垂坠耳环；额心加入一枚极小的冰蓝/银白宝石额饰。

身穿一套月白＋象牙白＋冰银＋极淡香槟金东方仙侠高级定制礼服。

内层为象牙白轻薄真丝裹胸式长裙，柔软自然褶皱，胸前采用克制的东方交叠结构。

肩部与胸侧覆盖大型立体银白凤凰羽毛装饰、银色牡丹花、金属花瓣和冰晶状刺绣。

外层披着极其轻薄的虹彩透明欧根纱仙袍，材质介于透明冰晶、珍珠薄膜和高级欧根纱之间，在阳光照射下产生极淡的蓝、粉、金、珍珠白虹彩反射。

宽大透明衣袖覆盖银白立体牡丹刺绣、羽毛纹、冰晶纹。

数条超长象牙白半透明披帛围绕人物飞舞，其中部分披帛从镜头前极近距离掠过，形成巨大的奶油色前景虚化。

所有衣料都必须具有真实物理重量与风力反馈，不要静止悬浮。

人物身体呈优雅的三分之二侧身。上半身略微向画面右侧转动。一只手轻轻放在锁骨与胸前衣料附近，手指纤细自然。另一条手臂向画面右上方高高抬起，仿佛正在控制、抓住或穿过被狂风卷起的巨大透明披帛。头部微微抬起，视线看向画面右上方远处，而不是直接看镜头。表情安静、冷艳、略带神性，没有明显笑容，整体动作像电影中仙姬站在雪山之巅召唤风雪的一瞬间。

背景为极其宏大的喜马拉雅式雪山群、冰川山峰和白色云海。远处大量尖锐雪峰穿过云层。天空为非常干净的低饱和冰蓝色。空气极其通透，具有高海拔环境特有的清晰度。远景雪山略微虚化，但仍能辨认真实岩石、积雪、冰川纹理。不要宫殿，不要室内，不要普通树林。

金色日出或傍晚 Golden Hour。太阳位于人物右上方偏后位置，形成强烈但柔和的暖金色侧逆光。阳光穿过透明披帛产生大量柔和折射、耀斑、光斑和珍珠色高光。人物脸部保持柔和自然补光。鼻梁、嘴唇、肩膀和锁骨出现非常细腻的暖金高光。黑色飞舞发丝边缘产生漂亮的银金色轮廓光。银色凤凰冠和金属花卉出现克制的镜面反射。透明衣料形成明显的虹彩折射。大量近距离披帛遮挡镜头，产生奶油白、香槟金色圆形散景和梦幻 Bloom。高光允许轻微溢出，但人物眼睛、五官和部分发丝必须保持清晰。

9:16竖屏电影构图，中近景至半身构图，人物位于画面中央偏左，头部约位于画面上方1/3区域，轻微低机位仰拍，镜头距离约1.5–2.5米，85mm等效电影人像镜头，f/1.8–f/2.2，浅景深。

镜头前方必须存在多层半透明披帛、银白羽毛或冰晶装饰作为前景。部分前景严重失焦，占据画面右侧以及上下边缘，形成偷窥式、包围式电影构图。人物眼睛与脸部为主要焦点，背景雪山自然虚化。
items.contentEnglish:
Hyper-realistic live-action Eastern mythological cinematic portrait of an adult East Asian woman aged 25 or above, standing atop a very high snow mountain above a sea of clouds, transformed into a silver phoenix fairy from a snowy celestial realm, blending Eastern xianxia, phoenix mythology, ice-snow saintess aesthetics, high-fashion editorial, and cinematic concept art.

She has a cool, refined East Asian oval face with soft yet defined contours, a delicate jawline, dark almond eyes with a cold, distant gaze and a slight divine aura, slender natural brows, a straight elegant nose bridge, and pale coral-pink lips slightly parted.

Use extremely subtle ice-snow xianxia makeup, with a small amount of warm orange-red / light coral eyeshadow around the eyes to create a cool-warm contrast against the white snow mountains; visible skin pores and fine peach fuzz, with natural translucency on the face. No influencer face, no plastic smoothing.

Her hair is thick, long, and black, styled as a classical high half-up bun with abundant loose lengths. Strong mountain wind blows from the right side of the frame toward the back-left, sending many black strands flying upward, with small wisps crossing the cheeks, lips, and near the eyes, creating a strong dynamic cinematic-capture feeling.

On her head, wear a large silver-white phoenix-wing headdress, combining outspread phoenix wings, feathers, ice crystals, and ornate Eastern metal engraving, with real carved texture and subtle scratches.

Hang many thin silver chains, crystal tassels, and pearl chains from both sides of the headdress, swaying in different directions under the strong wind.

Wear large pearl drop earrings, plus a tiny ice-blue / silver-white jewel ornament at the center of the forehead.

Outfit: an Eastern xianxia high-fashion couture dress in moon white, ivory white, ice silver, and a very faint champagne gold.

The inner layer is an ivory-white lightweight silk strapless long gown with soft natural folds and a restrained Eastern overlapping structure at the chest.

The shoulders and side chest are covered with large three-dimensional silver-white phoenix feathers, silver peonies, metal petals, and ice-crystal embroidery.

An extremely lightweight iridescent sheer organza outer robe drapes over the body, between transparent ice crystal, pearl film, and premium organza, producing very subtle blue, pink, gold, and pearl-white iridescent reflections under sunlight.

Wide transparent sleeves are covered with silver-white three-dimensional peony embroidery, feather patterns, and ice-crystal motifs.

Several extra-long ivory-white semi-transparent sashes swirl around the subject, with some passing very close to the lens to create large creamy foreground blur.

All fabrics must show real physical weight and wind response; do not let them float motionlessly.

The pose is an elegant three-quarter view. The upper body turns slightly to the right side of the frame. One hand rests lightly near the collarbone and chest fabric with slender natural fingers. The other arm is raised high toward the upper-right of the frame, as if controlling, catching, or passing through a huge transparent sash whipped by the wind. The head is slightly lifted, the gaze directed toward the distant upper-right, not at the camera. The expression is calm, glamorous, slightly divine, with no obvious smile, like a cinematic fairy standing on a snowy peak and summoning wind and snow.

The background is an immense Himalayan-like mountain range, glaciers, and a white sea of clouds. Many sharp snow peaks pierce through the cloud layer in the distance. The sky is a clean, low-saturation icy blue. The air is extremely clear, with the crispness of a high-altitude environment. The distant mountains are slightly blurred but still show real rock, snow, and glacier textures. No palace, no interior, no ordinary forest.

Golden hour at sunrise or sunset. The sun is positioned slightly behind and above the subject on the upper-right, creating strong yet soft warm golden rim light. Sunlight passing through the sheer sashes produces soft refractions, flares, highlights, and pearl-toned speculars. The face has soft natural fill light. Subtle warm gold highlights appear on the nose bridge, lips, shoulders, and collarbones. The edge of the flying black hair catches beautiful silver-gold rim light. The silver phoenix crown and metal floral elements show restrained mirror reflections. The transparent fabrics produce obvious iridescent refraction. Many close foreground sashes create creamy-white and champagne-gold bokeh and dreamy bloom. Highlights may slightly clip, but the eyes, facial features, and some strands of hair must remain sharp.

9:16 vertical cinematic composition, medium-close to half-body framing, subject positioned slightly left of center, head around the upper third of the frame, slight low-angle shot, camera distance about 1.5–2.5 meters, 85mm equivalent cinematic portrait lens, f/1.8–f/2.2, shallow depth of field.

There must be multiple layers of semi-transparent sashes, silver-white feathers, or ice-crystal ornaments in the foreground. Some foreground elements should be heavily out of focus, occupying the right side and the top/bottom edges, creating a voyeuristic, enveloping cinematic composition. The eyes and face are the primary focus, and the mountain background naturally falls off into blur.

Photography keywords: ultra realistic, photorealistic, cinematic, adult East Asian woman, pearl white fantasy gown, silver phoenix crown, pearl tassel earrings, pearl-white flowing gauze, cloud-like skirt, high updo with half-down hair, sacred feel, ethereal feel, blue sky background, natural highlights, oriental fantasy goddess, high-end fashion editorial, glossy glazed texture.

items.title: 晨花淡紫和服侧坐人像提示词

items.contentChinese:
主题：
晨花淡紫和服人像

主体：
画面中央，一位年轻女性坐在有花朵和朝阳的和洋室沙发上。她穿着白色底、淡紫花纹的和服，系紫色腰带，左下方伸出一条腿，侧脸和胸口为主视觉。

人物与表情：
细长卵形脸，小巧下巴，低垂的淡褐色眼睛，细眉，清秀鼻梁，略微张开的红桃色唇。脸朝画面左下方，神情安静，目光看向左肩指尖。明亮棕色长发在后脑勺松散束起，配薄刘海和脸侧发束，右后方有白色小花发饰。

服装与姿势：
和服从双肩大幅滑落，底色由白到浅紫，散布紫、青、淡桃色菊花和小花，胸口深V敞开。腰间系浓淡紫色织纹腰带，中央有珍珠风花朵装饰。人物斜坐在沙发上，左腿向前伸展，右臂支撑身体，左手指尖触碰左肩领口。

背景与光线：
画面左后方有大木框窗户，透明花瓶中插着白与紫的花朵，旁边有水杯；画面右后方有木制梳妆台、圆镜、玻璃瓶和和纸灯罩的灯。白色长毛沙发与花纹靠垫。左窗射入柔和晨光，照亮脸庞、肩膀、和服与前方腿部。

构图与镜头：
3:4纵向构图，从略高于坐姿人物胸部的正面左侧镜头取景，收录从头顶到前方大腿中央。人物置于中央偏右，左腿位于左下方，窗户和花朵位于左上方。腿部和右臂在画面边缘裁切，侧脸与和服花纹清晰对焦，背景柔和虚化。

质感与风格：
照片般的真实写实风格，自然肌肤、光泽头发、和服织纹与淡雅花样、腰带、珍珠装饰、白色长毛沙发细节清晰，整体为白色、浅紫、木色的明亮细腻晨光。

负面：
肩膀被和服完全覆盖；改变淡紫花纹与坐姿。
items.contentEnglish:
Theme:
Morning floral lavender kimono portrait

Subject:
A young woman sits on a sofa in a Japanese-Western room with flowers and morning sunlight. She wears a white kimono with pale lavender floral patterns and a purple obi, with one leg extending toward the lower left; the side face and chest are the main focus.

Appearance and expression:
A slender oval face, small chin, downcast light brown eyes, thin eyebrows, a neat nose bridge, and slightly parted glossy red-peach lips. Her face turns toward the lower left of the frame, with a calm expression looking at the fingertips near her left shoulder. Her long bright brown hair is loosely tied at the back of her head, with thin bangs and face-framing strands, plus a small white flower hair ornament at the back right.

Clothing and pose:
The kimono-like dress is largely slipped off both shoulders, with a base color shifting from white to light lavender and scattered with purple, blue, and pale pink chrysanthemums and small flowers; the chest is deeply open in a deep V. A woven obi in layered purple tones is tied at the waist, with a pearl-like flower ornament in the center. She sits diagonally on the sofa, stretching her left leg forward, supporting her body with her right arm, while the fingertips of her left hand touch the collar at her left shoulder.

Background and light:
A large wooden-framed window is in the left rear, with a transparent vase holding white and purple flowers and a water cup nearby; in the right rear are a wooden dresser, round mirror, glass bottles, and a paper-shade lamp. A white long-pile sofa and floral cushions are present. Soft morning sunlight from the left window lights the face, shoulders, kimono, and front leg.

Composition and camera:
Vertical 3:4 composition, shot from a slightly higher front-left angle than the seated subject’s chest, framing from the top of the head to the middle of the front thigh. Place the subject large in the center-right, the left leg in the lower left, and the window and flowers in the upper left. Crop the leg and right arm at the frame edge, keep the side face and kimono floral pattern in focus, and softly blur the background.

Texture and style:
Photorealistic real-life photography style, with natural skin, glossy hair, kimono weave and delicate floral patterns, obi, pearl ornament, and the white long-pile sofa rendered in high detail, under bright and delicate morning light in white, light purple, and wood tones.

Negative:
A kimono fit that fully covers the shoulders; changing the pale lavender floral pattern and seated pose.

items.title: 东方戏曲人物水袖绘画：一袖起，满台风月
items.summary: 东方戏曲人物半侧面厚涂油画风格，强调大幅后仰姿态、白色水袖弧形结构、冷白侧光与深墨绿黑背景。
items.contentChinese:
16:9 横构图，东方戏曲人物绘画，干净大色块厚涂油画，轻微水彩湿边，低饱和舞台色彩。

人物位于画面中央偏左，摄影机从她的正侧面略低位置拍摄。她完全呈侧脸，头部大幅后仰，下巴抬高，双眼闭合，颈部与下颌形成一条修长连续曲线。

一只手从胸前缓慢抬起，指尖靠近喉咙；另一只手向身后大幅甩开，带动一条巨大的白色水袖从人物身后向画面右上方形成长而优雅的弧形结构。

水袖不要复杂褶皱，而是由象牙白、浅灰白和少量淡蓝灰三四块大色面构成。

戏曲凤冠轮廓高而复杂，但细节集中在头部。人物面部以暖灰肤色、珊瑚红眼妆、朱红嘴唇塑形。

一道冷白光从画面左上后方照来，侧脸大部分留暗，只在鼻尖、上唇、下巴、颈部与锁骨留下几个干净而醒目的亮色色块。背景保持深墨绿黑色，几乎没有环境。
items.contentEnglish:
16:9 horizontal composition, an oriental opera figure painting, clean large color blocks in thick oil paint, slight watercolor wet edges, low-saturation stage colors.

The figure is placed slightly left of center, shot from a slightly low position on her strict side profile. Her head is tilted far back, chin lifted, eyes closed, and the neck and jawline form a long continuous curve.

One hand slowly rises from the chest with fingertips near the throat; the other arm swings far backward, carrying a huge white water sleeve that forms a long and elegant arc from behind the figure toward the upper right of the frame.

The water sleeve should not have complex folds, but be built from three or four large color areas in ivory white, pale gray white, and a little light blue-gray.

The opera phoenix coronet has a tall and intricate outline, with details concentrated on the head. The face is shaped with warm gray skin tone, coral red eye makeup, and vermilion lips.

A cold white light comes from behind the upper left, leaving most of the side face in shadow, with only a few clean and striking bright color blocks on the nose tip, upper lip, chin, neck, and collarbone. Keep the background deep dark ink green-black with almost no environment.

The background uses a [high-saturation color] with obvious thick paint texture. Sunlight falls on the subject, creating warm golden light and shadow with clear warm-cool contrast. items.title: 双重曝光人像生成提示词

items.contentChinese:
生成一张双重曝光人像构图，主体为上传的女性照片，要求保持面部与上传照片完全一致。

前景为全彩、全身人像：女性坐在底部一张低矮的白色凳子上，身体微微前倾，一只手放在腿上，另一只手靠近脖子，温柔地看向左侧，带着柔和自然的微笑。

服装为优雅的浅蓝色刺绣民族套装（anarkali/lehenga 风格），带半透明袖子、精致珠饰、搭配围在颈部的薄纱 dupatta，双腕佩戴传统金属手镯，耳戴华丽 jhumka 耳环。头发为松散凌乱的盘发，脸周围有自然散落的发丝。

前方有两只白鸽飞过。

背景为同一女性的巨大、淡化的黑白极近景肖像，与前景人物朝向一致，并无缝叠加在后方。背景采用梦幻、高调明亮的光效与柔和散景。

整体风格：工作室氛围感摄影、无缝双重曝光编辑、柔和漫射自然光、精致粉彩色调、电影感浅景深、高分辨率、8K 人像摄影。

参数与要求：保持面部与上传照片完全一致，画幅比例 4:5。
items.contentEnglish:
Create a double-exposure portrait composition featuring the uploaded woman, with the face kept exactly the same as in the uploaded photo.

The foreground should be a full-color, full-body portrait: the woman sits gracefully on a low white stool at the bottom, leaning slightly forward, one hand on her lap and the other near her neck, gazing warmly to the left with a soft natural smile.

She is wearing an elegant pastel blue embroidered ethnic suit (anarkali/lehenga style) with sheer sleeves, delicate beadwork, a matching sheer dupatta around the neck, traditional metallic bangles stacked on both wrists, and ornate jhumka earrings. Her hair is styled in a soft messy updo with loose strands framing her face.

Two white pigeons are flying in front of her.

In the background, place a large, faded monochrome extreme close-up portrait of the same woman looking in the same direction, seamlessly layered behind the foreground figure. The background should have a dreamy, high-key bright lighting effect with soft bokeh.

Overall style: studio glamour photography, seamless double-exposure edit, soft diffused natural daylight, delicate pastel tones, cinematic shallow depth of field, high resolution, 8k portrait photography.

Requirements: maintain the face exactly the same as the uploaded photo, aspect ratio 4:5.

items.title: GPT Image 2.5 黑白钢笔人物手稿 Prompt
items.summary: 以参考图人物为原型，保留五官、神态、服饰与姿态，生成大师级黑白钢笔人物手稿，强调墨线、排线、留白与复古纸张质感。
items.contentChinese: 以参考图人物为原型，保留五官特征、神态、服饰与身体姿态，去除原始背景，重新创作成大师级黑白钢笔人物手稿。采用精湛的传统钢笔绘画技法，以灵动流畅的墨线、细密交叉排线、自然断笔与大胆留白塑造人物的立体感和艺术张力。面部精细刻画，服饰线条疏密有致，局部保留起稿痕迹与随性的未完成笔触，呈现真实艺术家亲笔创作的质感。暖象牙色复古素描纸，清晰可见纸张纤维与细腻墨迹，黑白灰层次丰富。极简艺术画册排版，大面积留白，角落点缀手写签名与创作日期。整体优雅、自由、富有艺术收藏价值，拒绝数字描摹与AI滤镜感，9:16竖版高清构图。
items.contentEnglish: Using the person in the reference image as the prototype, preserve the facial features, expression, clothing, and body pose, remove the original background, and recreate it as a master-level black-and-white pen figure sketch. Use exquisite traditional pen drawing techniques, with fluid ink lines, fine cross-hatching, natural broken strokes, and bold negative space to build three-dimensional form and artistic tension. Render the face in detail, keep the clothing lines dense and well-ordered, and partially preserve sketch marks and casually unfinished strokes to convey the texture of a true hand-drawn artwork. Use warm ivory vintage sketch paper with visible paper fibers and delicate ink traces, with rich black, white, and gray layers. Apply minimalist art-book layout, large areas of blank space, and add handwritten signature and creation date in the corner. Overall elegant, free, and collectible, rejecting digital tracing and AI-filter aesthetics, in a high-definition 9:16 vertical composition.

items.contentChinese: 反复修改提示词，挑战 ChatGPT 生成一张类 Midjourney 风格的中式戏曲神女写实人像。主体为一位极其美丽的年轻东亚女性，具有空灵的中国帝制戏曲女神气质，细腻瓷白面容，精致五官，带忧郁感的杏眼，淡烟熏眼妆，柔和玫瑰色唇妆，冷淡疏离的表情。佩戴华丽宏大的中国凤凰冠，饰有精细蓝色珐琅镂空纹样、古银饰、无数发光白珍珠、雕塑感象牙花朵与金属植物结构。身穿奢华传统中国礼服，象牙白丝绸材质，精美手工刺绣牡丹，颜色包含暗青蓝、柔和珊瑚粉和古金色，垂坠珍珠项链与精致珊瑚流苏。自然倚靠在绣花丝绸上的纤细手部，五根手指解剖结构准确、比例优雅、关节真实、透视自然。大幅飘逸的白色丝绸袖子，长黑发在风中戏剧性飞扬。背景为模糊的古代中国宫殿建筑。采用戏剧性的近景时尚肖像，略微低机位，构图讲究且不对称，浅景深，前景丝绸轻微虚化；中国神秘主义与欧洲洛可可装饰相结合，老大师绘画般的色彩关系，电影感明暗对照，冷蓝灰氛围，柔和暖色高光，真实瓷肤质感，细腻织物细节，克制 HDR，写实高级时尚摄影，85mm 人像镜头，f/1.8，工艺精湛，博物馆级视觉美感，优雅而略带幽灵感的美。--ar 9:16 --v 8.2 --stylize 250 --chaos 8 --no extra fingers, fused fingers, malformed hands, distorted anatomy, plastic skin, cartoon, anime, text, watermark

The subject is an extraordinarily beautiful young East Asian woman with an ethereal Chinese imperial opera goddess aura, a delicate porcelain face, refined facial features, melancholic almond-shaped eyes, subtle smoky eyeliner, soft muted rose lips, and a cold, distant expression. Flowing oversized white silk sleeves and long black hair blow dramatically in the wind. The background features softly blurred ancient Chinese palace architecture. Use a dramatic close-up fashion portrait, a slightly low camera angle, sophisticated asymmetrical composition, shallow depth of field, and softly out-of-focus foreground silk; combine Chinese mysticism with European Rococo ornamentation, Old Master painting color harmony, cinematic chiaroscuro, a cool blue-gray atmosphere, delicate warm highlights, realistic porcelain skin texture, intricate textile details, restrained HDR, photorealistic fine art fashion photography, an 85mm portrait lens, f/1.8, extraordinary craftsmanship, museum-quality visual aesthetics, and an elegant, haunting beauty. --ar 9:16 --v 8.2 --stylize 250 --chaos 8 --no extra fingers, fused fingers, malformed hands, distorted anatomy, plastic skin, cartoon, anime, text, watermark

items.title: 真人转插画的左右分栏海报提示词
items.summary: 整理自 X 的真人转插画案例提示词，保留左右分栏、原图保真、右侧手绘涂鸦、留白与文字排版限制。
items.contentChinese:
请将我上传的每张照片分别处理为独立的高端设计海报，不要多图拼接，每张照片单独输出。整体采用 16:9 横构图，左侧保留原图，右侧进行涂鸦插画处理。

左侧原图需完整保留，保持主体身份、结构、姿态、真实质感、自然光影与原始色彩氛围，只做轻微的高级调色，呈现艺术杂志和展览图像的质感。为适配画幅，可自然延展环境背景，但主体不能被拉伸、变形或改动。

右侧进行新的艺术判断，只提取照片中最有识别度的主体、轮廓、结构、姿态和叙事关系，重构为手绘涂鸦生活插画 / 朴拙插画 / 马克笔绘画。不要保留全部物体，不要复制原始场景；主动删减大部分背景和无关信息，通过删除、重组、裁切和比例变化重新组织画面，让普通构图也能转化为有效作品。

造型应简化、符号化、松弛且个性化，使用略微抖动、间歇、不完全规整的手绘线条，以及马克笔、蜡笔、油画棒般的自然上色。允许轻微线条交叠、留白和手工误差，不追求写实比例、完整透视或细节刻画。

右侧以大量有意识留白为核心，实色图形只占很小比例，其余空间主动留空。主体可以偏角、贴边、悬浮或局部裁切，位置由姿态方向与视觉重心决定。留白与主体共同形成正负形、距离、停顿和呼吸感，宁可少画也不要填满画面。

图形与文字必须作为整体重新编排，而不是简单地“上面一行字、下面一个形”。先建立无形网格、视觉轴线和阅读路径，再决定文字位置；文字可以贴近主体轮廓、顺着动作方向、对齐头部或肩线、落入大块负空间，或与图形形成错位、穿插、非对称呼应。避免机械居中、上下堆叠和固定模板，让图形负责情绪，文字负责节奏，两者共同完成构图。

文字不限制语言，只保留极少量真正有意义的词语或短语。使用轻盈、自然的手写字体，字宽和笔画压力略有变化，保留一点随手书写感，但字间距、行距和整体位置必须通过编辑设计控制。可用一个稍微醒目的短句配合微小辅助文字形成层级，但不要使用菜单式标题、长文案或整页文字。

颜色采用柔和、明亮、疗愈的限定色盘，从原图中提炼最关键的颜色，重组为奶油黄、桃粉、珊瑚红、天蓝、湖蓝、嫩绿、淡紫等清新色彩；鲜艳但不刺眼，柔和但不脏灰，并以暖白或极浅复合色作为大面积呼吸空间。

整体追求朴拙绘画、成熟构图、聪明的图文关系和大量留白，像高端独立杂志、生活方式编辑插画或艺术出版物，而不是儿童涂鸦本。避免固定的居中主体加居中文案、随意散落的小图标、复杂背景、信息堆砌、塞满画面、廉价卡通感和模板化排版。

当前用户确认的编辑规范，优先于上方冲突的排版要求：
横向 16:9，左侧原图、右侧涂鸦等分。右侧保留小个子女性形象，粉色发带、白色毛衣、花朵裙摆和简化自行车轮廓，右侧画面占比约 20%，使用三条受控的手势线，整体以奶油色留白为主。文字为 SLOW AFTERNOON。
原图面板必须忠实保留，不要拉伸。输入图像为 AI 生成，不是真实照片。不要额外人物，不要男性角色或男性手部。
items.contentEnglish:
Please process each uploaded photo as an independent high-end design poster. Do not stitch multiple images together; output each photo individually. Use a 16:9 horizontal composition overall, with the original image on the left and doodle illustration treatment on the right.

The left original panel must be preserved faithfully, keeping the subject’s identity, structure, posture, real texture, natural light and shadow, and original color atmosphere, with only slight high-end color grading to give it the texture of art magazines and exhibition images. To fit the frame, the environmental background may be naturally extended, but the subject must not be stretched, distorted, or altered.

The right side should make a new artistic judgment, extracting only the most recognizable subject, outline, structure, posture, and narrative relationship from the photo, and reconstructing it as hand-drawn doodle lifestyle illustration / naïve illustration / marker drawing. 构图：将两个面板上下堆叠，中间用清晰的水平分割线分开。上方照片约占画面 60%，下方插画约占 40%。保持孩子的外貌、服装颜色、姿势和周围环境在两个面板中都可辨识且一致。整体采用柔和怀旧色彩、轻快叙事、温馨家庭相册美学、真实手工魅力；上半部分要求高质量写实摄影质感，下半部分要求富有纹理的蜡笔艺术效果，竖版 4:5 构图。

重要：两个面板必须描绘同一时刻和同一主体。上半部分必须像真实照片，下半部分必须像儿童亲手绘制。不要将插画与照片混合。避免 3D 卡通渲染、数字矢量艺术、过度精致的插画、人工皮肤和过多装饰元素。
items.contentEnglish:
GPT Image 2.5 on ChatGPT

Create a charming, heartwarming two-panel vertical collage inspired by nostalgic childhood photography and handmade children’s crayon drawings.

TOP PANEL — PHOTOREALISTIC PHOTO: Capture a candid, ultra-realistic photograph of a happy young child enjoying a simple outdoor adventure in a beautiful countryside meadow. The child wears colorful, playful everyday clothing and a cute hat or headscarf, with a natural, spontaneous pose interacting with fluffy sheep grazing nearby. Alternatively, capture the child joyfully jumping in the air against a vivid blue sky. Use bright natural sunlight, authentic skin texture, realistic fabric details, soft shadows, natural colors, and an unposed documentary photography aesthetic. The scene should feel like a genuine childhood memory captured by a professional family photographer.

BOTTOM PANEL — MATCHING CRAYON DRAWING: Directly beneath the photograph, create a handmade children’s illustration of the exact same child, outfit, pose, and main subjects from the photograph. Use visible wax crayon strokes, colored-pencil scribbles, uneven hand-drawn outlines, imperfect proportions, and a warm ivory paper texture. Add small flowers, grass, clouds, a smiling sun, and playful decorative doodles. Include a few short handwritten words in colorful childlike lettering, such as “Little Moments, Big Joy” or “Jump for a Brighter Day.”

COMPOSITION: Stack both panels vertically with a clean horizontal division. The top photograph occupies approximately 60% of the image; the illustrated panel occupies the remaining 40%. Keep the child’s appearance, clothing colors, pose, and surroundings recognizable across both panels. Soft nostalgic colors, cheerful storytelling, wholesome family-album aesthetic, authentic handmade charm, high-quality photorealism in the upper panel, richly textured crayon artwork in the lower panel, portrait 4:5 composition.

IMPORTANT: The two panels must depict the same moment and subject. The upper half must look like a real photograph, while the lower half must look genuinely hand-drawn by a child. Do not blend the illustration into the photograph. Avoid 3D cartoon rendering, digital vector art, overly polished illustrations, artificial skin, and excessive decorative elements.

items.title: 超广角虫视角摄影工作流
items.summary: 将普通视角照片重构为低机位超广角虫视角摄影，强调强烈透视、空间包围感与真实纪实质感。
items.contentChinese:
请将上传的普通视角照片重新创作为一张具有强烈空间冲击力的摄影级真实照片。

核心视觉：低机位虫视角 + 超广角摄影 + 戏剧性透视 + 建筑包围感 + 沉浸式环境摄影。

01｜照片内容识别
- 上传照片作为唯一场景与主体参考。
- 自动识别人物、建筑、自然景观、道路、地面与背景空间的结构关系。
- 尽可能保持原照片中的人物身份、服装、建筑特征、场景地点、主要材质与光线氛围。

02｜重新设计相机机位（最高优先级）
- 彻底改变原照片的普通平视角度。
- 将虚拟相机移动到距离地面约20—40厘米的位置，靠近主要人物或场景前景。
- 镜头向上大幅仰拍，形成极强的低机位虫视效果。
- 采用全画幅等效13—16mm超广角镜头，展现近大远小的夸张透视、边缘空间拉伸和强烈纵深。
- 绝不是简单裁剪、旋转或者给原图叠加鱼眼滤镜，必须重新构建符合新相机位置的空间透视。

03｜主体与构图
- 有主要人物时，将人物布置在画面下方或中下部，优先采用背面、侧背面或自然站立的低角度构图。
- 人物下半身因靠近镜头而产生真实的透视放大，上半身与远处环境产生明显尺度对比。
- 没有人物时，以原照片中最具代表性的建筑、树木或物体作为前景透视主体。
- 天空或建筑顶部构成画面的视觉中心。

04｜环境空间
- 建筑从左右两侧或多个方向向上延伸，突出巨大的空间包围感。
- 如果原场景具有中庭、环形、弧形或围合式建筑结构，强化其环绕式仰拍效果，让天空成为中央开放区域。
- 如果原场景是普通街道、广场、寺庙或自然风景，则根据真实环境自动形成合理的超广角透视，不强行创造不存在的环形建筑。
- 允许根据新视角合理补全原照片未拍摄到的天空、地面和建筑侧面，但必须符合原场景的结构与风格。

05｜摄影质感
- 真实手机0.5×超广角摄影质感，自然日光、真实阴影、丰富建筑细节、较深景深、轻微数码颗粒和真实边缘畸变。
- 画面具有偶然街拍的纪实感，而不是人工设计的3D效果图。

06｜画幅
- 3:4竖版，强调从近处地面到高处天空的巨大空间跨度。

负面约束
- 不要普通平视摄影、不要常规低角度半身人像、不要航拍、不要微缩星球、不要360度全景球、不要圆形黑边鱼眼、不要夸张到不真实的建筑弯曲、不要改变人物身份和主要服装、不要复制参考图的建筑与人物、不要插画感和CG渲染感。
items.contentEnglish:
Please transform the uploaded ordinary-view photo into a photorealistic image with strong spatial impact.

Core visual: low-angle worm's-eye view + ultra-wide-angle photography + dramatic perspective + architectural enclosure + immersive environmental photography.

01 | Photo content recognition
- Use the uploaded photo as the only scene and subject reference.
- Automatically identify the relationships among people, buildings, natural landscapes, roads, ground, and background space.
- Preserve the identity, clothing, architectural features, location, main materials, and lighting atmosphere from the original photo as much as possible.

02 | Redesign the camera position (highest priority)
- Completely change the ordinary eye-level angle of the original photo.
- Move the virtual camera to about 20–40 cm above the ground, close to the main subject or foreground.
- Tilt the lens sharply upward to create a very strong low-angle worm's-eye effect.
- Use a full-frame equivalent 13–16 mm ultra-wide lens to show exaggerated perspective, stretched edge space, and strong depth.
- Do not simply crop, rotate, or add a fisheye filter; the spatial perspective must be rebuilt according to the new camera position.

03 | Subject and composition
- When there is a main person, place the subject in the lower or lower-middle area of the frame, preferably from the back, side-back, or in a natural standing low-angle composition.
- The lower body appears larger due to proximity to the lens, creating a clear scale contrast with the upper body and distant environment.
- When there is no person, use the most representative building, tree, or object from the original photo as the foreground perspective subject.
- The sky or the top of the building should become the visual center of the frame.

04 | Environmental space
- Buildings extend upward from both sides or multiple directions, emphasizing a massive enclosing sense of space.
- If the original scene has a courtyard, circular, curved, or enclosed architectural structure, strengthen the surrounding upward-looking effect and make the sky the central open area.
- If the original scene is a street, square, temple, or natural landscape, form a reasonable ultra-wide perspective based on the real environment without forcing nonexistent circular architecture.
- It is allowed to reasonably complete unseen sky, ground, and building sides from the new viewpoint, but the result must match the structure and style of the original scene.

05 | Photographic texture
- Real smartphone 0.5× ultra-wide photography texture, natural daylight, real shadows, rich architectural details, deep depth of field, slight digital grain, and realistic edge distortion.
- The image should feel like an accidental street snapshot, not a manually designed 3D render.

06 | Aspect ratio
- 3:4 vertical composition, emphasizing the huge spatial span from the near ground to the high sky.

Negative constraints
- No ordinary eye-level photography, no standard low-angle half-body portrait, no aerial view, no tiny planet, no 360-degree panorama sphere, no circular black-border fisheye, no unrealistic architectural bending, no changing subject identity or main clothing, no copying the reference image's building and people, no illustration or CG-rendered look.

items.title: 地下漫画风格半身海报提示词
items.summary: 整理为地下漫画风格的半身照海报生成提示词，保留粗粝印刷质感、夸张人物比例和复古限色排版。
items.contentChinese:
保守整理后的中文提示词：

使用上传的单张照片作为主体唯一来源，将其转换为一张大胆的复古插画角色海报，融合表现性编辑漫画夸张风格、地下漫画墨线绘制和做旧丝网印刷质感，印在旧化的奶油色纸张上。只输出一张完成后的转化海报。

保留原图的主要主体、可识别的发型、胡须、肤色倾向、年龄和性别呈现、标志性配饰、服装类别、代表性色彩、姿势、手势以及与现有物体的互动。保持原图的头部角度和整体视角。通过这些线索而不是精确面部测量来保留身份特征。允许大幅卡通化重塑眼睛、眉毛、鼻子、脸颊、下颌和嘴巴。成年人仍应保持成年感，同时具备夸张、俏皮的比例。

绘制略微放大的头部、宽阔的上半脸、明显的脸颊形状和收窄的下半脸。眼睛要显著放大，呈细长杏仁形，带有温暖的象牙白眼白、深色虹膜和明确的黑色上眼睑。将瞳孔放在与原图视线一致的位置，必要时强调偏侧或向上看的视线。保留与原表情一致的眨眼或半眯眼状态，避免统一的睁眼凝视。使用有力度的眉毛、用少量墨线和一个角度化的暖色阴影概括鼻子，并用自信曲线绘制独特的嘴部。根据人物保留闭嘴、微笑、微张嘴等表情，不要强行套用同一种笑容。露出牙齿时，仅用简单的象牙色形状表示。根据人物调整睫毛、唇部强调、胡须线、雀斑和面部细节，不要套用千篇一律的脸。

在轮廓、头发、眼睛、服装和重要物体周围使用强烈且自然变化的黑色墨线。内部阴影区域加入更细的毛糙笔线、短方向排线和局部交叉排线。头发应由大块流动发束和深色团块构成，辅以有生命力的弧形墨线和少量暖色高光。保留原有发型和色系。面部毛发用紧凑深色块面和短粗线表现。服装通过大色块、清晰褶皱和少量有节奏的笔触来概括。用少量平面阴影块建立体积，不使用摄影式渐变。

使用紧凑的印刷色板：旧化象牙白、接近黑的炭黑、温暖赭石或桃色肤色、棕色，以及少量人物特定点缀色，如灰粉、番茄红、芥末黄、低饱和薄荷绿或汽油青蓝。保留原图中可识别的颜色，但转换为有冲击力的复古印刷色。默认使用强烈的汽油青蓝背景；如果更适合主体气质和服装，也可使用深炭黑背景。保持人物与背景清晰分离。肤色应表现为温暖的图形色块，带克制的脸颊红润和墨线细节，而不是柔软的空气刷肖像阴影。

在人物和背景上都加入真实的旧印刷质感：可见纸张纤维、细颗粒、零星掉墨、略不均匀的墨层、刮擦色块、干刷边缘和轻微褪色区域。保持底下的绘画清晰可读。添加一圈狭窄、不规则的旧纸边缘，边角磨损，墨边有擦伤。整体应像印在吸墨纸上的老插画海报，呈现哑光平涂和触感瑕疵，而不是光亮的数字渲染。

让主角在前景中占据主导。保留原图可见的身体范围和核心手势，将构图适配为竖版海报，不要凭空添加未见的手、腿或道具。在上方背景放置一行超大号奶油色标题，部分被人物头发或轮廓遮挡。标题应为粗糙的全大写手绘刷字，字宽不一、间距不规则、斜向强烈、刷痕边缘毛糙并有缺墨。让文字横跨海报大部分宽度，同时保持脸部不被遮挡。保留足够的字形结构以便短语仍可辨认。

可选标题：[TITLE]。可选小号手写注释：[NOTE]。按提供文本原样呈现。如果 TITLE 为空或省略，则生成一个两到四个英文单词的短语，表达原图的情绪或动作。如果 NOTE 省略，则根据空间补充一句简短的相关手写说明，或在空间有限时省略。不要显示占位符。不要自动复制其他图片的口号，不要引入脏话，也不要为主体编造个人身份声明。

将原始场景简化为少量大胆的插画环境形状。只加入少量相关外围细节，例如与来源相关的物体、胶带纸条或两到三个快速手绘强调标记。它们必须次于人物和标题。不要在没有来源支持或明确要求的情况下，自动增加咖啡、植物、猫、珠宝、星星、家具或新的手势。

优先表现有张力的卡通面部结构、利落的黑色墨线、大胆的限色块、超大号刷字排版和真实的做旧印刷效果。避免写实面部几何加纹理滤镜、精致粉彩娃娃风、标准精修二次元、小比例Q版身体、平滑矢量描边、水彩晕染、光泽空气刷、摄影背景、3D渲染、过度装饰、额外主体、畸形手部、签名、水印和界面元素。只输出完成的插画海报，不要保留原始照片或对照布局。
items.contentEnglish:
Conservatively organized English prompt:

Use the single uploaded photograph as the sole source for the subject. Transform it into a bold vintage illustrated character poster combining expressive editorial caricature, underground comic ink drawing, and distressed screen printing on aged cream paper. Output one finished transformed poster only.

Preserve the principal subjects, recognizable hairstyle, facial hair, skin-tone family, age and gender presentation, distinctive accessories, clothing categories, signature colors, pose, gesture, and interaction with existing objects. Keep the source head angle and general viewpoint. Preserve identity through these selected cues rather than exact facial measurements. Allow substantial cartoon redesign of the eyes, brows, nose, cheeks, jaw, and mouth. Keep adults visually adult while giving them expressive, playful proportions.

Draw a slightly enlarged head with a broad upper face, prominent cheek shapes, and a compact tapered lower face. Make the eyes conspicuously large, elongated almond shapes with broad warm-ivory whites, dark irises, and decisive black upper eyelids. Position the pupils clearly toward the source gaze direction, emphasizing an off-center sideways or upward glance when appropriate. Keep a wink or narrowed eye consistent with the original expression. Avoid a uniformly wide-eyed stare. Use strong expressive eyebrows, a simplified nose defined by a few ink marks and one angular warm shadow, and a distinctive mouth drawn with confident curves. Preserve a closed mouth, grin, parted lips, or other expression without imposing the same smile on everyone. Suggest teeth as simple ivory shapes when visible. Adapt lashes, lip emphasis, beard marks, freckles, and facial details to the person instead of applying one generic face.

Use strong, organically varied black ink contours around the silhouette, hair, eyes, clothing, and important objects. Add finer scratchy pen lines, short directional hatching, and selective cross-hatching inside shadow areas. Hair should consist of large flowing locks and dark masses with lively curved ink strokes and a few warm highlights. Preserve the actual hairstyle and color family. Render facial hair with compact dark shapes and short rough strokes. Describe clothing through broad color regions, clear folds, and sparse energetic pen marks. Build volume with a few flat shadow shapes rather than photographic gradients.

Use a compact palette of opaque printing inks: aged ivory, near-black charcoal, warm ochre or peach skin tones, brown, and a few character-specific accents such as dusty pink, tomato red, mustard, muted mint, or petrol turquoise. Preserve recognizable source colors while translating them into punchy vintage ink colors. Default to a strong petrol-turquoise background; use deep charcoal when it better supports the source mood and clothing. Keep the figure clearly separated from the background. Skin should read as warm graphic color with restrained cheek blush and ink detail, not softly airbrushed portrait shading.

Apply convincing worn-print texture across both figure and background: visible paper tooth, fine grain, scattered missing-ink flecks, slightly uneven ink coverage, scratched color areas, dry-brush edges, and lightly faded patches. Maintain crisp readable drawing underneath the distress. Add a narrow irregular aged-cream paper margin with worn corners and scuffed ink edges. The artwork should resemble an old illustrated poster printed on absorbent paper, with matte flat colors and tactile imperfections rather than glossy digital rendering.

Make the main character dominant in the foreground. Preserve the source’s visible body range and essential gesture, adapting the composition to a vertical poster without inventing unseen hands, legs, or props. Place an oversized cream headline across the upper background, partially behind the character’s hair or silhouette. Draw the headline as rough uppercase hand-painted brush lettering with uneven widths, irregular spacing, strong diagonals, ragged dry-brush ends, and visible missing ink. Let the words span most of the poster width while keeping the face unobstructed. Preserve enough letter structure for the phrase to remain readable.

Optional headline: [TITLE]. Optional small handwritten note: [NOTE]. Reproduce supplied text exactly. If TITLE is blank or omitted, generate a short two-to-four-word English phrase expressing the source image’s mood or activity. If NOTE is omitted, either add one brief context-related handwritten note or omit it when space is limited. Never display placeholders. Do not automatically copy slogans from other images, introduce profanity, or invent personal claims about the subject.

Simplify the original setting into a few bold illustrated environmental shapes. Include only a small selection of relevant peripheral details, such as a source-related object, a taped paper note, or two or three quick hand-drawn accent marks. Keep these secondary to the character and headline. Do not automatically add coffee, plants, cats, jewelry, stars, furniture, or a new hand gesture unless supported by the source or explicitly requested.

Prioritize expressive cartoon facial construction, confident black ink drawing, bold limited-color shapes, oversized brush typography, and authentic distressed printing. Avoid realistic facial geometry with a texture filter, delicate pastel doll styling, standard polished anime, tiny chibi bodies, smooth vector outlines, watercolor washes, glossy airbrushing, photographic backgrounds, 3D rendering, excessive decoration, extra subjects, malformed hands, signatures, platform watermarks, and interface elements. Output only the completed illustrated poster, with no original photograph or comparison layout.

items.contentEnglish:
Autumn natural casual outfit prompt:
The color palette is warm taupe, oatmeal beige, ivory, and muted rust.
The outfit includes a cropped open-knit sweater, tailored trousers, a felt fedora, a small color-block bag, and pointed low heels.
The sweater is loose fitting, with a high ribbed mock neck, dropped shoulders, long wide sleeves with flared ribbed cuffs, a broad ribbed waistband, and a chunky airy knit with visible vertical and horizontal stitches.
The high-waisted taupe trousers have a clean tailored shape, subtle front pleats, a straight wide leg, and a pressed center crease.
The soft brown fedora has a gently pinched crown, a medium curved brim, and a broad ivory band.
The compact rectangular bag combines rust-orange and dark brown panels with a thin pale blue cord handle.
The pointed low heels are ivory taupe with dark brown inset panels and slim heel shapes.

items.title: 厚涂油画风提示词分享
items.summary: 分享一段厚涂油画风生成提示词，强调主体、场景、色彩、厚重笔触、调色刀纹理与戏剧性光影。
items.contentChinese: 厚涂油画风：以[主体]置于[场景]中，包含[独特视觉元素]、[动态构图]、[色彩搭配]，采用厚重雕塑感笔触、层层堆叠的油彩、强烈的调色刀肌理、大胆的手势性笔触、夸张造型、浓郁饱和色、可见的颜料起伏、富有表现力的运动感、具触感的三维堆积、鲜明对比、戏剧性定向光照、当代美术风格、白色背景。
items.contentEnglish: Impasto oil painting: [subject] in [setting], featuring [distinctive visual elements], [dynamic composition], [color palette], thick sculptural brushstrokes, heavily layered oil pigments, dramatic palette knife textures, bold gestural mark-making, exaggerated forms, rich saturated colors, visible paint ridges, expressive movement, tactile three-dimensional paint buildup, striking contrasts, dramatic directional lighting, contemporary fine art aesthetic, white background.

items.title: 秋季制服穿搭提示词：柔和秋日学院风套装
items.summary: 一组秋季制服穿搭提示词，围绕暖象牙白、燕麦米与灰蓝色的柔和学院风造型，包含贝雷帽、短外套、格纹层次与蝴蝶结细节。
items.contentChinese: 秋季制服穿搭提示词，柔和学院风造型。配色为暖象牙白、燕麦米色与低饱和灰蓝色，整体为协调统一的秋日穿搭。浅浅圆润帽冠的贝雷帽，帽型低平，窄折边，带一个小小的灰蓝色丝带点缀。米 beige 短外套为及臀长度，轮廓宽松微 oversized，长袖，肩部微微聚拢，罗纹袖口，前襟简洁，小浅色纽扣，两侧圆角贴袋并带细微缝线细节；每只袖子都有一枚浅灰蓝色蝴蝶结装饰。外套内为象牙白连衣裙，上身修身干净，简单圆领，短裙摆微微展开，底边为清晰的三角形轮廓。下方露出一层蓝灰与象牙白格纹百褶裙，细密窄褶，短 A 字版型。脖子上围一条轻薄米色格纹围巾，松松绕一圈，前垂，末端带细流苏。白色过膝袜，袜口附近有小灰蓝色蝴蝶结。柔软象牙白针织腿套在脚踝上方自然堆叠成褶，搭配棕色玛丽珍鞋，圆头，细带。
items.contentEnglish: Autumn uniform outfit prompt, a soft academy-style look. The color palette is warm ivory, oatmeal beige, and muted blue-gray, keeping the overall outfit coordinated and clean for an autumn feel. A beret with a softly rounded crown, shallow shape, narrow folded band, and a small blue-gray ribbon accent. A beige hip-length jacket with a relaxed, gently oversized silhouette, long sleeves, softly gathered shoulders, ribbed cuffs, a simple front opening with small pale buttons, and two rounded patch pockets with subtle stitched details; each sleeve is decorated with a pale blue-gray bow. Under it is an ivory dress with a clean fitted upper section, a simple round neckline, and a gently flared short skirt with a crisp triangular hem. A separate blue-gray and ivory plaid pleated skirt peeks out underneath, with fine narrow pleats and a short A-line shape. A lightweight beige plaid scarf is wrapped loosely once around the neck and hangs down the front with fine fringe. White over-the-knee socks have small blue-gray bow accents near the top. Soft ivory knitted leg warmers gather in gentle folds above brown Mary Jane shoes with rounded toes and slim straps.

items.title: 秋棠旧梦｜民国复古东方名媛秋日轻奢服装设计
items.summary: 民国复古风服装设计，以深栗棕、酒红和香槟金营造秋日浪漫与古典轻奢氛围，呈现东方名媛气质。
items.contentChinese: 民国复古 × 东方名媛 × 秋日浪漫 × 古典轻奢风格服装设计。以深栗棕、复古酒红与暖香槟金为主色调，将民国时期的海派名媛美学与现代精致时装融合。上装为立领盘扣印花旗袍式内搭，外披棕金色提花短外套，宽袖内衬酒红丝绒，强调端庄气质与层次感。下装搭配高腰收腰设计的复古伞摆长裙，采用不对称织锦拼接与细腻花卉纹样，增强视觉韵律。搭配酒红丝绒珍珠网纱小礼帽、复古花卉耳坠、深棕刺绣手套、酒红金丝绣花玛丽珍高跟鞋，整体呈现温婉、知性、华贵、略带怀旧气息的民国秋日名媛风情。保留服装设计表达，不扩展为人物写真或摄影大片。
items.contentEnglish: Republican-era retro × oriental lady × autumn romance × classic light-luxury fashion design. Use deep chestnut brown, vintage burgundy, and warm champagne gold as the main palette, blending Shanghai-style lady aesthetics from the Republican era with modern refined fashion. The top features a stand-collar, frog-button, printed qipao-style inner layer, with a brown-gold jacquard short jacket on top and burgundy velvet lining inside the wide sleeves, emphasizing elegant structure and layered detail. The lower part uses a high-waisted, waist-cinching retro umbrella skirt with asymmetric brocade patchwork and delicate floral patterns to enhance visual rhythm. Accessories include a burgundy velvet pearl mesh mini hat, vintage floral earrings, dark brown embroidered gloves, and burgundy-and-gold embroidered Mary Jane heels, creating a gentle, intellectual, luxurious, and slightly nostalgic Republican-era autumn lady aesthetic. Keep it as fashion design content and do not expand it into a portrait or photography scene.

items.title: 高奢时装 × 动物互动的角色插画系列
items.summary: 保留经典角色识别度，以高奢时装与动物温柔互动为核心，采用克制背景、二渲三发束与商业插画质感。
items.contentChinese:
【角色】与【动物】，明确成年角色形象，日系商业美少女插画 × 韩系女性向网络漫画 × 当代生活方式插画 × 高级时装角色立绘 × 精修彩色线稿 × 柔性赛璐珞上色 × 二渲三发束塑形 × 高清洁净商业插画。
保留【角色】最核心的身份识别：发型、发色、眼睛、面部结构、角色主色、标志性配饰、身份符号与整体气质。人物为成年年轻女性，五官精致、气质成熟、身体比例修长优雅。
【动物】保持自然、可爱、生动的真实形态，与角色形成温柔亲密的日常互动：抚摸额头、抱在怀里、趴在腿上、低头对视、接住小爪子、依偎在身边等，动作自然、温柔、好读。
服饰根据角色身份重新设计为 luxury fashion house styling，高级成衣、精致剪裁、丝质、针织、皮革、珠宝、金属配件与 designer fashion silhouette，不需要大面积品牌 Logo。
3:4 竖版，中景到全身构图。minimal clean backdrop × large negative space × luxury editorial simplicity，背景使用暖白、低饱和纯色色场、浅灰白空间或简洁色块，仅保留极少量装饰。
clean colored line art × variable line weight × soft cel shading × smooth digital painting × semi-cel rendering。头发采用明确二渲三处理：4–7 组中型发束，清楚的穿插与厚度关系，丝带状长条高光，发根、内层、耳后与发束交叠处形成结构暗部，减少碎发和漂浮细丝。
high-key diffuse lighting × controlled shadow modeling，补足刘海、眼窝、鼻翼、下巴、颈部、服装褶皱与人物接触动物位置的柔和结构阴影。
材质精细表现针织、丝质、皮革、金属、珠宝与动物毛发。pastel low-contrast palette × elegant luxury neutrals × muted editorial harmony，保留角色原设主色，再以奶油白、米杏、浅驼、烟粉、雾灰、深蓝、灰棕、金属金辅助。
整体呈现 Japanese commercial character illustration × Korean romance webtoon × luxury editorial lifestyle art × soft cel shading × semi-cel anime hair rendering × intimate animal interaction × minimalist background × designer fashion lookbook feeling。
3:4 竖版，旁边一个青金石蓝小圆点，无其他文字。
items.contentEnglish:
【Character】and【Animal】, clearly adult character depiction, Japanese commercial cute-girl illustration × Korean female-oriented webtoon × contemporary lifestyle illustration × high-fashion character full-body art × refined colored line art × soft cel shading × semi-3D hair rendering × clean commercial illustration.
Preserve the character’s core identity: hairstyle, hair color, eyes, facial structure, main character color, signature accessories, identity symbols, and overall temperament. The character is an adult young woman with refined features, mature aura, and long elegant proportions.
The【Animal】should remain natural, cute, and lively in a realistic form, creating gentle and intimate daily interaction with the character: stroking the forehead, holding in arms, lying on the lap, looking down face to face, catching a little paw, leaning close, with natural, soft, and readable actions.
Redesign the clothing according to the character identity into luxury fashion house styling, with high-end ready-to-wear, precise tailoring, silk, knitwear, leather, jewelry, metal accessories, and designer fashion silhouettes, without large brand logos.
3:4 vertical composition, medium shot to full-body framing. Minimal clean backdrop × large negative space × luxury editorial simplicity, using warm white, low-saturation solid fields, light gray-white space, or simple color blocks, with only minimal decoration.
Clean colored line art × variable line weight × soft cel shading × smooth digital painting × semi-cel rendering. Hair should use a clear semi-3D treatment: 4–7 medium hair clumps, clear overlap and thickness relationships, ribbon-like long highlights, with structural shadows at the roots, inner layers, behind the ears, and hair-clump overlaps, reducing stray hairs and floating fine strands.
High-key diffuse lighting × controlled shadow modeling, adding soft structural shadows on the bangs, eye sockets, nose wings, chin, neck, clothing folds, and the contact area between the character and animal.
Fine material rendering for knitwear, silk, leather, metal, jewelry, and animal fur. Pastel low-contrast palette × elegant luxury neutrals × muted editorial harmony, keeping the original character main color and adding cream white, oatmeal, light camel, dusty pink, mist gray, deep blue, gray-brown, and metallic gold as supporting tones.
Overall style: Japanese commercial character illustration × Korean romance webtoon × luxury editorial lifestyle art × soft cel shading × semi-cel anime hair rendering × intimate animal interaction × minimalist background × designer fashion lookbook feeling.
3:4 vertical. Tiny “voxcat” signature on the right edge, with a small lapis blue dot beside it, no other text.

items.title: 橙色连帽工装外套主导的户外风休闲穿搭提示词
items.summary: 保守整理一则以橙色连帽工装外套为主角的户外风休闲穿搭提示词，保留服装层次、配色与配饰细节。
items.contentChinese: 橙色连帽工装外套为主角的户外风休闲穿搭提示词：亮橙色长款连帽外套敞开穿作最外层，及膝长度，宽翻驳领，宽松帽兜，长袖带纽扣袖口袢，臀部有大翻盖口袋，双排扣圆扣前襟；内搭浅粉色短款吊带背心，软 V 领口，细蕾丝包边，胸下聚拢拼接，小前系带；下装为浅天蓝色高腰修身牛仔裤，带腰袢、前口袋和清晰缝线；脚穿米色系带踝靴，圆头、厚平台底和粗跟；搭配橙色报童帽，浅蓝灰色帽檐。
items.contentEnglish: Outdoor casual outfit prompt centered on an orange hooded utility jacket: a bright vivid orange long hooded coat worn open as the main outer layer, knee length, broad notched lapels, a roomy hood, long sleeves with buttoned cuff tabs, large flap pockets at the hips, and a double-breasted front with round buttons; paired with a pale pink cropped camisole with a soft V neckline, fine lace edging, a gathered empire seam, and a small front tie; light sky blue fitted jeans with a high waist, belt loops, front pockets, and visible stitching; beige lace-up ankle boots with rounded toes, thick platform soles, and block heels; matched with an orange newsboy cap with a pale blue gray visor.

items.title: 粉紫荷叶边衬衫叠穿炭灰吊带围裙裙的甜蜜哥特洛丽塔服装提示词
items.summary: 粉紫长袖荷叶边衬衫叠穿炭灰围裙裙：方领吊带、密集荷叶边与金铜扣细节的甜蜜哥特洛丽塔提示词。
items.contentChinese: 粉紫/尘玫粉色长袖衬衫，高圆领，领口有大号同色蝴蝶结；前襟有褶皱荷叶边围兜与小装饰纽扣；袖子为直筒长袖，袖口为层叠荷叶边收口。叠穿在炭灰色围裙连衣裙之下：围裙裙为贴身上身，方领；宽肩带，外缘有密集灰色荷叶边；正面有两列竖排的四颗古铜色纽扣；腰部为宽而贴身的结构，双层细扣带与金属眼孔（左右两侧各有）。裙摆为短款聚褶外扩，带多层蓬量分段，每一层底边有细密褶裥带、荷叶边与细微蕾丝饰边；整体围裙裙为深灰面料。画面呈现：粉紫衬衫与炭灰围裙裙形成清晰对比；甜蜜哥特洛丽塔风，结构化上身、柔软聚褶裙摆，强调做工缝线与面料褶皱细节。
items.contentEnglish: Dusty mauve pink long-sleeved blouse with a high rounded collar, a large matching bow at the neckline, a gathered ruffle-front bib and small decorative buttons, long straight sleeves finished with layered ruffled cuffs, worn beneath a charcoal gray pinafore dress, the dress has a fitted bodice with a square neckline and broad shoulder straps edged with dense gray ruffles, four bronze-toned buttons arranged in two vertical rows on the front, a wide fitted waist with narrow double buckle straps and metal eyelets at both sides, a short gathered flared skirt with several voluminous tiers, each tier finished with fine pleated bands, ruffles and subtle lace trim, dark gray fabric throughout the pinafore, clear contrast between the muted pink blouse and charcoal gray dress, coordinated sweet gothic lolita fashion, structured bodice, soft gathered skirt, detailed stitching and fabric folds

items.title: 栗棕色复古学院风针织穿搭
items.summary: 一组以栗棕、驼色、奶油色与低饱和蓝为主色的复古学院风服装提示词，重点描述针织纹理、层叠搭配与装饰图案。
items.contentChinese: 超大版型栗棕色针织开衫，采用休闲落肩剪裁、宽大衣袖、罗纹袖口与下摆、大号棕色纽扣，以及石板蓝和暖棕色的撞色罗纹门襟。衣袖与前身饰有菱形阿盖尔纹和小巧的奶油色雏菊图案，并加入装饰性插画布片与贴袋。内搭浅奶油色尖领衬衫，搭配一条印有彩色故事书场景的宽长领带。下装为驼棕色高腰百褶迷你裙，带短款叠搭百褶裙片，内配同色合身短裤；搭配带矩形金属扣的深棕色皮带和柔软毛毡材质的暖赭色贝雷帽。整体为栗棕、驼色、奶油色与低饱和蓝色协调组合的复古学院风造型，呈现清晰的针织纹理、服装层次和细致明确的图案。
items.contentEnglish: An oversized chestnut-brown knit cardigan with a relaxed drop-shoulder fit, very wide sleeves, ribbed cuffs and hem, large brown buttons, and contrasting slate-blue and warm-brown ribbed front bands. Diamond argyle patterns with small cream daisy motifs cover the sleeves and front, alongside decorative illustrated fabric panels and patch pockets. Layer it over a pale cream pointed-collar blouse and a long, wide necktie printed with colorful storybook scenes. Pair it with a camel-brown high-waisted pleated mini skirt featuring a short overlapping pleated flap and matching tailored shorts underneath, plus a dark brown leather belt with a rectangular metal buckle and a warm ochre soft-felt beret. Keep the vintage academic palette coordinated in chestnut, camel, cream, and muted blue, with visible knit texture, clear garment layering, and carefully defined patterns.

items.title: 《武士杰克》角色皮克斯风格 3D 重塑
items.summary: 将《武士杰克》角色转化为高品质皮克斯风格3D形象，保留标志性设计与可识别特征，并以全身构图呈现于纯白背景。
items.contentChinese: 将[《武士杰克》角色]重新诠释为高品质皮克斯风格的3D角色，保留其标志性角色设计、可辨识的面部特征和标志性发型，以及[独特服装]、[武器或配饰]、[面部表情]、[动态姿势]。将风格化的棱角比例转化为圆润但富有雕塑感的3D造型，呈现富有表现力的动画角色面部特征、真实的皮肤纹理和细致的织物材质。采用电影感角色灯光、高端3D动画渲染和精致纹理；全身构图，纯白背景。
items.contentEnglish: Reinterpret a [Samurai Jack character] as a premium Pixar-style 3D character, preserving the iconic character design, recognizable facial features, and signature hairstyle, along with [distinctive outfit], [weapon or accessory], [facial expression], and [dynamic pose]. Translate the stylized angular proportions into rounded yet sculptural 3D forms, with expressive animated facial features, realistic skin textures, and detailed fabric materials. Use cinematic character lighting, high-end 3D animation rendering, and polished textures; full-body composition on a pure white background.

items.title: 芥末黄背景手绘卡通角色海报
items.summary: 以芥末黄色为背景，创作一幅竖版手绘卡通角色插画，呈现戴黑框眼镜的年轻男子及其随性神情，并采用现代动画图像小说风格。
items.contentChinese:
创作一幅细节丰富的手绘 2D 卡通角色插画，采用时髦、前卫的现代动画图像小说风格。
主体：一名古怪的年轻男子，头部比例偏大、身形纤瘦，略显凌乱的尖刺发型，戴粗框超大黑色眼镜和黑色小耳钉；五官夸张且富有表现力，有灵动的眼睛、小鼻子和浅浅的坏笑，神情自信而略带不耐。
姿势：腰部以上肖像，身体稍微侧转，头部微微上扬，目光望向一侧，姿态放松随意。
服装：宽松的黑色街头风 T 恤，带醒目的橙色图形字样，呈现自然布料褶皱和细微明暗。
画风：干净有力的黑色墨线轮廓、夸张的卡通比例、平滑赛璐璐着色、温暖肤色、清晰高光、细微笔触质感，呈现精致的手绘动画效果。
背景：纯色鲜亮芥末黄，简洁无杂物，角色周围留有充足留白。
构图：竖版 9:16 海报，角色居中并略低于画面中部，完整呈现头部和上半身。
质量与限制：高分辨率数字插画、专业角色设计、个性鲜明、线条一致、电影感光照；不要水印、额外物件或边框，不要照片写实风格。
items.contentEnglish:
Create a highly detailed, hand-drawn 2D cartoon character illustration in a stylish, edgy, modern animated graphic-novel aesthetic.
Character: A quirky young man with an oversized head and slim body, slightly messy spiky hair, thick oversized black glasses, and small black ear studs. Give him exaggerated, expressive facial features, lively eyes, a small nose, a subtle smirk, and a confident, slightly unimpressed expression.
Pose: Waist-up portrait, body turned slightly sideways, head tilted upward, eyes looking off to the side, with a relaxed and casual posture.
Outfit: An oversized black streetwear T-shirt with bold orange graphic lettering, natural fabric folds, and subtle shading.
Art style: Clean, bold black ink outlines, exaggerated cartoon proportions, smooth cel shading, warm skin tones, crisp highlights, subtle textured brushwork, and a polished hand-drawn animation aesthetic.
Background: Solid vibrant mustard yellow, minimal and uncluttered, with generous negative space around the character.
Composition: Vertical 9:16 poster, character centered and positioned slightly below the middle, with the head and upper torso fully visible.
Quality and constraints: High-resolution digital illustration, professional character design, expressive personality, consistent linework, and cinematic lighting. No watermark, extra objects, or border; no photorealism.

items.title: 松散水彩晕染风格
items.summary: 分享一条用于生成抽象水彩画的提示词，以可替换主体为对象，强调松散大笔触、流动色块、湿画法渗化、简化造型与留白构图。
items.contentChinese: 以[主体]为对象的抽象水彩晕染画，松散夸张的大笔触与宽阔流动的色块，细节极少；柔和的颜料渗化和富有表现力的湿画法肌理，造型简化，构图轻盈通透；白色背景，不使用线稿或轮廓线。
items.contentEnglish: An abstract watercolor wash of [subject], with loose oversized brushstrokes and broad flowing color shapes, minimal detail; soft pigment bleeding and expressive wet-on-wet texture, simplified forms, airy composition; white background, no linework or outlines.
